vetSays.line: 🛡️ Devon, the person in their 50s, Thanat and the man in his 30s, the veterinarian met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Devon, the person in their 50s, Thanat, the man in his 30s, the veterinarian are hurt.
🛡️ Devon, Arlo, Jessica, Thanat and Victor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Arlo, Thanat, Victor are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jessica just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Arlo, Thanat, Aroha, Victor and Tariq met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Arlo, Thanat, Aroha, Victor, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thanat just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Devon, Arlo, Thanat, Victor and Stan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Thanat, Victor, Stan are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Stan showed Victor the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Meera showed Boris the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

regDeaths.name: stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
a soft green glow under the water
a shadow moving wrong against the sun
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
stripes flowing where no wind blows
